AboutUsSection.subtitle: A personal Spanish academy shaped by real classrooms, international experience and meaningful conversation.
paragraphs: After teaching in two schools in France and working with international academies, María has spent more than four years helping students of different ages, backgrounds and goals build confidence in Spanish.
That experience now shapes CostaSpanish: practical lessons built around real conversation, culture and the person learning — online or in our academy in Torrox.

TestimonialsSection.title: Real students. Real feedback.
TestimonialsSection.supporting: Experiences from people who have learned Spanish with María online and in person.

ali.text: Maria is a wonderful teacher! She explains everything clearly, corrects my mistakes in a very helpful way, and makes every lesson enjoyable. Highly recommended!

claire.text: Maria is the best teacher! She is super friendly and motivating, and she is very good at correcting and explaining mistakes. I have tried many Spanish teachers in the past and Maria is my favourite because she really takes the time to personalise the lessons around your interests, level and goals. She also sends all the lesson notes, along with really useful materials to practise between classes. I highly recommend her!

caus.text: Maria is an absolute gem! She is so patient, understanding, organised and knowledgeable!

jeff.text: A++ Maria is ALWAYS prepared and organised, and her classes go by quickly and are fun. She keeps track of progress and exercises from lesson to lesson without forgetting where we left off. An easy and wholehearted recommendation.

liz.text: I can thoroughly recommend Maria. Her lessons are well planned and professionally taught.

pierre.text: A very thoughtful teacher who takes the time to understand her students and continually adapts her lessons to their needs.
